The '''Royal Galaxy Hotel''' was a [[Hotel/Legends|hotel]] in [[Curamelle/Legends|Curamelle]] on [[Corulag/Legends|Corulag]]. Located in Curamelle's tallest building, its roof was the site of a dramatic escape by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] members from [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] agents in [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]].<ref name="SF">{{JournalCite|12|Small Favors}}</ref>
